description: This file defines the API for validating OpenType tables within the FreeType font rendering library. It includes function declarations, constants, and documentation related to OpenType table validation.

methods.name: FT_OpenType_Validate
methods.description: Validates specified OpenType tables in a font face to ensure offsets and indices are correct.

methods.name: FT_OpenType_Free
methods.description: Frees buffers allocated during OpenType table validation.
